standard-dialogue.npc: 'Ello, and what are you after then?

options.text: I need another assignment.

steps.player: I need another assignment.

steps.text: If the player doesn't have an assignment yet:

steps.npc: Excellent, you're doing great. Your new task is to kill [amount] [task monster].

options.text: Got any tips for me?

steps.player: Got any tips for me?

steps.text: Kuradal provides the corresponding Slayer task tip.

steps.player: Great, thanks!

options.text: Okay, great!

steps.player: Okay, great!

steps.npc: Good luck! Don't forget to come back when you need a new assignment.

steps.text: If the player already has an assignment:

steps.npc: You're still hunting [monster]; you have [amount] to go. Come back when you've finished your task.

steps.text: If the player already has an assignment, and they have become ineligible for this assignment:

steps.npc: You're still hunting [monster], with [amount] to go.
I don't think that's a suitable task for you. Shall I cancel it? This will not wipe your task streaks.

options.text: Yes, please cancel it.

steps.player: Yes, please cancel it.

steps.npc: Alright, consider the task cancelled. You can now get a new assignment when you want one.

options.text: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.

steps.player: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.

steps.npc: Good luck with that.

options.text: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?

steps.player: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?

steps.npc: I have quite a few rewards you can earn, and a wide variety of Slayer equipment for sale.

options.text: Look at rewards.
Look at shop.
Cancel.
Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.

steps.player: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.

steps.text: If the player has disabled combat checking:

steps.npc: The Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.

options.text: That's fine - I can handle any task.

steps.player: That's fine - I can handle any task.

steps.npc: That's the spirit.

options.text: In future, please don't give anything too tough.

steps.player: In future, please don't give anything too tough.

steps.npc: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.

steps.text: Slayer Masters will now take the player's combat level into account.
If the player has enabled combat checking:

steps.npc: The Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.

options.text: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.

steps.player: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.

steps.npc: Okay, we'll keep checking your combat level.

options.text: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!

steps.player: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!

steps.npc: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will assign you anything from their lists, regardless of your combat level.

steps.text: Slayer Masters will no longer take the player's combat level into account.

options.text: Tell me about your skillcape, please.
options.condition: If the player does not have 99 Slayer:

steps.player: Tell me about your skillcape, please.

steps.npc: This is a Slayer's Skillcape. Only a true Slayer master is permitted to wear one and in recognition of such an achievement, Slayer masters may be persuaded to allow you to select the same assignment in a row.
You need more training before you earn that honour, though.

options.text: Can you sell me a Slayer Skillcape?

steps.player: May I buy a Slayer's Skillcape, please?

steps.npc: Well you have performed well as a student. I guess you have earned the right to wear such a prestigious cape now. The Slayer masters will recognize this cape and may offer you the same assignment twice in a row.
That will be 99000 coins, please.

options.text: I've changed my mind, I don't want it.

steps.player: I've changed my mind; I don't want it.

steps.npc: Okay. Well, if you change it back again, I will be waiting.

options.text: Great; I've always wanted one!

steps.npc: Well, come back and see me when you do.

steps.text: If the player has at least 99,000 coins but not enough inventory space:

steps.npc: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.

steps.text: If the player has at least 99,000 coins and enough inventory space:

steps.npc: Good hunting, [player name].

options.text: So you're filling in for Duradel?

steps.player: So you're filling in for Duradel?

steps.npc: I am. The task he has been given is an important one, but this post must always be filled. Who better to fill it than his own daughter.

steps.player: Daughter? So being a Slayer Master runs in the family?

steps.npc: Of course. One cannot simply grow up with someone like my father. My childhood consisted of a lot of training. My father has always been among the best, but he wanted me to be even better.

steps.player: Sounds like a lot of hard work.

steps.npc: Yes, but we wouldn't have it any other way.

options.text: About Duradel...

steps.player: About Duradel...

steps.npc: Are you here with news on Lucien?

steps.player: I'm afraid not.

steps.npc: The moment you find him, you must come to me. I will ensure my father is avenged!

steps.player: He wouldn't want you to get yourself killed as well!

steps.text: If the player has not yet received Duradel's notes:

steps.npc: I will not suffer the same fate as my father. I intend to be prepared. For a start, I have been researching my father's notes to find weaknesses in Lucien's demonic thralls.

steps.player: Those sound interesting. May I see them?

steps.npc: Of course. If we expect to defeat Lucien, we must work together.

steps.text: Kuradal hands you an old notebook.
If the player has received Duradel's notes:

steps.npc: I will not suffer the same fate as my father. That fate is reserved for Lucien!

steps.player: I hope you're right...

steps.text: If the player has not read Duradel's notes and it is not in their possession:

steps.npc: I will not suffer the same fate as my father. I intend to be prepared. For a start, I have been researching my father's notes to find weaknesses in Lucien's demonic thralls.

steps.player: Speaking of those notes, I seem to have misplaced them. Do you happen to have another copy?

steps.npc: Luckily for you, I made many.

steps.text: If the player has sufficient inventory space:
If the player has no free inventory space:

steps.npc: Return to me when you have space to carry them.

options.text: Er... Nothing...

steps.player: Er... Nothing...

getting-a-task-bypassing-the-combat-leve.npc: Your cape attests that you are experienced enough to be taught by me. I will overlook your lack of experience in combat.
